summary.text: Ellin Leonard is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Leonard is a Conway resident who said in a Ballotpedia survey that she worked in sales for more than 20 years, served seven years on the Conway Budget Committee and was a library trustee; she also ran for the state House in 2020.

paragraphs.text: Ellin Leonard earned a high school diploma from Alton High School.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a New Hampshire native who has made Conway her home for more than two decades.
She said she worked in sales for more than 20 years, served on the Conway Budget Committee for seven years, and was a library trustee.
Ballotpedia lists Leonard as a candidate for the state House in Carroll 2 in 2020, when she lost the general election.

Leonard said in the 2026 survey that she would support state investment in water and sewer infrastructure to enable more housing, work to fund public schools properly, and oppose the Education Freedom Account program.
She also said she refuses outside campaign funding.
